title: 5-Day Casablanca & Marrakech City Journey
metaDescription: Combine Casablanca and Marrakech in five days, from modern urban landmarks to historic palaces, bustling souks and the atmosphere of the old medina.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 5-Day Casablanca & Fez Tour traces northern Morocco’s history from the Atlantic coast to the old medina of Fez. Begin in Casablanca before continuing to Rabat and Meknes, two imperial cities with distinct architectural and historical identities. At Volubilis, Roman ruins introduce an earlier period of Morocco’s past before the journey reaches Fez, where traditional workshops, narrow lanes and historic quarters remain central to the city experience.
Five days are devoted to this northern route, with private road transportation between destinations. Selected hotels, meals as specified, local guides, airport transfers, entrance fees and scheduled sightseeing are arranged as part of the journey.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Casablanca
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Airport and meet with our representative. Transfer to your hotel in Casablanca.
Hotel check-in after 14:00pm. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Casablanca

itinerary.title: Casablanca to Marrakech (240km)
itinerary.text: Morning city tour of Casablanca. Visit the Central Market, Habous District, Royal Palace, Mohammed V Square, and the Anfa residential area. See the exterior of the Hassan II Mosque. Optional seafood lunch before driving via highway to Marrakech. Overnight in Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Visiting Marrakech
itinerary.text: Full-day tour of Marrakech, known as the “Pearl of the South.” Visit the Menara Gardens, Saadian Tombs, Bahia Palace, and Dar Si Said Museum. Lunch at the hotel. Explore the souks and traditional handicraft quarters before visiting the famous Jemaa el-Fnaa square with its lively entertainment. Optional dinner with folkloric show at Chez Ali. Overnight in Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Marrakech to Casablanca (240km)
itinerary.text: Morning at leisure in Marrakesh for personal exploration. Early afternoon departure to Casablanca. Optional end of tour in Marrakesh for those who prefer to stay. Overnight in Casablanca.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Casablanca Airport
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel in Casablanca and check-out
Transfer to Mohammed V International Airport.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the Morocco Highlights – 5 Days tour?
faqs.a: The Morocco Highlights – 5 Days tour covers Casablanca and Marrakech, two of Morocco's most iconic destinations. This itinerary combines the country's modern commercial capital with its most vibrant imperial city, offering a perfect introduction to Moroccan culture, history, architecture, and local traditions. The tour runs for 4 nights and 5 days.

faqs.q: How much does the Morocco Highlights – 5 Days tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €995 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, private land transportation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, and transfers according to the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Is transportation included throughout the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, private land transportation is included throughout the journey. Comfortable vehicles are used for all transfers and sightseeing activities, ensuring a convenient and enjoyable travel experience.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels and traditional Moroccan riads with daily breakfast. Properties are chosen for their comfort, quality service, and authentic Moroccan atmosphere.

faqs.q: Does the tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guide will provide fascinating insights into Morocco's history, culture, architecture, and local customs throughout the trip.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Morocco?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors seeking a short but memorable introduction to Morocco. It combines the country's most famous city with its largest economic center, providing a well-rounded travel experience.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy. Travelers should be comfortable walking through medinas, local markets, historical monuments, and city centers. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Casablanca and Marrakech?
faqs.a: Casablanca is famous for the magnificent Hassan II Mosque, coastal scenery, and modern Moroccan lifestyle. Marrakech is renowned for its colorful souks, beautiful palaces, historic gardens, traditional architecture, and the lively Jemaa el-Fnaa Square, one of the most famous public squares in the world.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Morocco Highlights – 5 Days tour?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the Morocco Highlights – 5 Days tour be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade accommodations, include destinations such as Essaouira, Rabat, or the Atlas Mountains, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
